title: 第一卷 正文第21章 作死的苏媚第一卷 正文第22章 狼头刀斩金刀
content_zh:
这样的修炼速度，可以说是十分缓慢了。
但好在，这是宝塔第一层空间内的时间。外界才过去了半个月而已。
在这四年多里，楚凌天除了修为的提升外，还将《玄火剑指》从初入之境，修炼到了中成之境。将功法《火云诀》修炼到了圆满之境。
另外，他的炼丹水平勉强达到了一品高阶炼丹师。
如今他，已经可以炼制出绝品品质的蕴气丹。那一千份炼制蕴气丹所需的药材，共炼制成功了七百八十五次。其中，绝品蕴气丹不下五十颗。
这些蕴气丹都被楚凌天吞服了。
一千份炼制玄气丹所需的药材，到目前为止，消耗了四百份。只成功了十多次，炼制的丹药，全都是下品玄气丹。
虽然成功次数不多，但只要有了成功的经验，后面的成功率就会越来越高。
“该出去完成学宫任务了。”
楚凌天意念一动，离开宝塔第一层空间，回到宿舍内。
他检查了一下屋内的情况，确认没有人来过后，离开宿舍，朝着任务阁走去。
任务阁上下共三层，第一层可以领取1至3级外门任务，第二层可以领取4至6级外门任务，第三层则可以领取7至9级外门任务。
任务的等级越高，难度就越高，完成后获得的奖励也就越丰厚。
其中，普通的外门弟子只能在第一层领取任务，精英弟子可以前往第二层，潜龙榜上的强者则可以前往第三层。
此时，任务阁第一层内，有不少弟子正围在巨大的任务板前，挑选适合自己的任务。
楚凌天扫了一眼任务板。
一级外门任务：采摘两颗一品药材赤火果，两学分。
一级外门任务：获取一阶高级妖兽独角狼的妖丹，三学分。
二级外门任务：采摘一株二品药材灵岩草，十二学分。
二级外门任务：斩杀一头一阶高级妖兽金纹豹，十三学分。

三级外门任务：斩杀一头二阶低级妖兽铁背狼，四十学分。
三级外门任务：获取二阶低阶妖兽黑线蟒的妖丹，四十五学分。
……
“一至三级的外门任务，难度都不高。以我现在的实力，可以轻松完成。”楚凌天心中自语道。
铁背狼，是二阶低级妖兽，实力相当于灵师二重天的修士。
黑线蟒的实力要比铁背狼强大一些，相当于灵师三重天的修士。
楚凌天的修为虽然刚刚突破至灵师三重天初期，但他已将玄阶低级武技《玄火剑指》修炼至中成之境，若是爆发全力，即便是普通的灵师四重天修士都不是他的对手。更别说是铁背狼、黑线蟒了。
楚凌天来到管理任务阁第一层的孙长老面前，拱手道：“孙长老，我要接斩杀铁背狼、获取黑线蟒妖丹，两个三级外门任务。”
孙长老瞥了楚凌天一眼，冷漠地说道：“将你的身份令牌拿来。”
楚凌天闻言，从储物袋中取出身份令牌，递给孙长老。
content_en:
This kind of cultivation speed can be said to be very slow.
But fortunately, this is the time in the first level of the pagoda. Only half a month has passed in the outside world.
In the past four years, in addition to improving his cultivation, Chu Lingtian also cultivated "Xuanhuo Sword Finger" from the first stage to the middle stage. He practiced the "Fire Cloud Technique" to perfection.
In addition, his alchemy level barely reached the level of a first-level high-level alchemist.
Now, he has been able to refine the top quality Qi Accumulating Pill. The thousand medicinal materials required for refining the Qi Accumulating Pill were successfully refined a total of 785 times. Among them, there are no less than fifty top-grade Qi-accumulating Pills.
These Qi Accumulating Pills were all swallowed by Chu Lingtian.
Of the thousand medicinal materials required to refine the Xuan Qi Pill, four hundred have been consumed so far. It was only successful a dozen times, and the elixirs refined were all low-grade Xuanqi elixirs.
Although there are not many successes, as long as you have successful experience, the success rate will be higher and higher.
"It's time to go out and complete the Academy mission."
With a thought, Chu Lingtian left the first floor of the pagoda and returned to the dormitory.
He checked the situation in the house and after confirming that no one had been there, he left the dormitory and walked towards the mission pavilion.
There are three floors in the mission pavilion. On the first floor, you can receive level 1 to 3 external missions. On the second floor, you can receive level 4 to 6 external missions. On the third floor, you can receive level 7 to 9 external missions.
The higher the level of the task, the higher the difficulty, and the more generous the rewards you will get after completing it.
Among them, ordinary outer disciples can only receive tasks on the first level, elite disciples can go to the second level, and the strong ones on the Hidden Dragon List can go to the third level.
At this time, in the first floor of the mission pavilion, many disciples were gathered in front of the huge mission board, choosing missions that suited them.
Chu Lingtian glanced at the task board.
Level 1 outer door task: Pick two first-grade medicinal red fire fruits, two credits.
Level 1 external mission: Obtain the demon elixir of the level 1 advanced demon beast Unicorn Wolf, three credits.
Second-level outer door task: Picking a second-grade medicinal material, Lingyan grass, twelve credits.
Level 2 external mission: kill a level 1 advanced monster, the Golden Leopard, thirteen credits.
Level 3 outer sect mission: Kill a level 2 low-level monster, the Iron-backed Wolf, forty credits.
Level three outer door mission: Obtain the demon elixir of the second-level low-level demon beast Black Thread Python, forty-five credits.
…
"The outer sect tasks from level one to level three are not very difficult. With my current strength, I can easily complete them." Chu Lingtian said to himself.
The iron-backed wolf is a second-level low-level monster with a strength equivalent to that of a monk in the second level of a spiritual master.
The strength of the black thread python is stronger than that of the iron-backed wolf, which is equivalent to a monk from the third level of the spiritual master.
Although Chu Lingtian's cultivation has just reached the early stage of the third level of spiritual master, he has already cultivated the low-level martial arts "Xuanhuo Sword Finger" to the intermediate level. If he breaks out with all his strength, even ordinary fourth-level spiritual master monks are no match for him. Not to mention the iron-backed wolf and black-lined python.
Chu Lingtian came to Elder Sun, who was on the first floor of the management task pavilion. He cupped his hands and said, "Elder Sun, I want to take on two third-level outer sect tasks of killing the iron-backed wolf and obtaining the black-threaded python demon pill."
Elder Sun glanced at Chu Lingtian and said coldly: "Bring me your identity token."
Upon hearing this, Chu Lingtian took out the identity token from his storage bag and handed it to Elder Sun.
